instruction: Add the corresponding speaker notes from notes.docx to slides 1, 2, and 3 in the PowerPoint presentation, making sure the content is identical.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

expected_notes.1: Lecture slides DO NOT contain everything that is said in class, but you are still responsible for this content. So, make sure you bring yourself up-to-date if you miss a class
expected_notes.2: Lecture slides DO NOT contain everything that is said in class, but you are still responsible for this content So, make sure you bring yourself up-to-date if you miss a class

metadata.explanation: This task requires adding notes to slides 1, 2, and 3 (0-indexed: 0, 1, 2) from the notes.docx file. The evaluator checks that the notes content matches exactly what's expected from the Word document. Slide 1 should have 'Lecture 1', slide 2 and 3 should have the lecture disclaimer text. Partial credit is given (score = correct_slides / total_slides).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts notes text for specified slides (0, 1, 2) from the PowerPoint file
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type=rule by directly accessing expected.get(expected_notes)
Metric properly compares actual notes text with expected text using whitespace normalization
All 3 slides mentioned in instruction are verified - complete coverage
Partial credit logic is appropriate (proportion of correct slides)
Postconfig correctly saves the file with Ctrl+S before verification to ensure notes are persisted
Expected values are documented to come from notes.docx file with correct content for each slide
